results.title: NGO Trains Young Women On Governance, Policy Advocacy

results.title: Cost Of Living: ASCSN Demands N300,000 Minimum Wage Increase
results.content: The Association of Senior Civil Servants of Nigeria (ASCSN) on Thursday demanded an immediate increase in the minimum monthly salary of the lowest-paid federal worker to N300,000, rejecting temporary wage awards and palliatives as inadequate to address the rising cost of living. results.title: FG Considers Electric Buses To Ease Nigerians’ Transport Burden
results.content: The federal government is considering a private-sector-driven electric mass transit initiative aimed at reducing transportation costs for Nigerians across the six geopolitical zones.
